info.title: KoLo Gateway API
info.description: HTTP surface of one Kurahi gateway (one per identity). Generated from the route registry in src/gateway/http-routes.ts; the gateway serves the live copy at GET /doc. Every operation names its token class in `x-kolo-scope`. All HTTP requests share a per-IP sliding window (x-kolo-rate-limit) and credential-bearing requests also count against a 20/min credential-attempt limiter; both answer 429 with Retry-After. Routes that exist but are not described operation by operation are listed in x-kolo-undocumented-routes with the reason.

post.summary: Run a Code Mode script
post.description: Runs one agent-written JavaScript/TypeScript script in a sandboxed worker thread. The script calls the session's tools as `await tools.<name>({...})` and returns a value: one round trip instead of one call per tool. Tools are the session agent's policy-filtered list (core, plugin, `mcp:<server>:<tool>`); `allowTools` narrows it further. Limits: wall clock (default 60 s), heap, tool calls per script (default 200). Every tool call is audited under the run id. A backend with tools=none answers 403.

x-kolo-undocumented-routes.reason: Serves the agent canvas directory as static files plus a live-reload upgrade; gated for non-local clients like A2UI.
Lives under the configurable Control UI base path; gated for non-local clients. To be described when the Control UI routes move into the registry.
Public static bundle with an SPA fallback (any unknown GET under the base path returns index.html); all data flows over the authenticated WebSocket.

x-kolo-websocket.description: JSON frames over one WebSocket. The first request must be `connect` (ConnectParams, auth.token = gateway secret or a paired device token); the gateway answers hello-ok. Then `req` frames call methods and `event` frames stream server events. The schema for the frames alone is published as dist/protocol.schema.json.
x-kolo-websocket.rateLimit: 10 new connections per minute per IP; 30 messages per second per client
